program_name: Nexo Affiliate Program (Affiliate track / Business track)
application_conditions: Form (name, email, role, contact via Telegram/WhatsApp/LinkedIn); individual review; 'Request invitation' suggests selectivity; no minimum audience.
paid_action: Share of fee revenue: trading fees, credit interest/loan volume, yield, futures; 'Nexo Card transactions' listed without a rate.

commission.model_note: Up to 50% of trading fees; up to 50% of interest revenue or up to 4% of loan volume; up to 10% of yield; card rate not stated; varies by track, region, tier.

revenue_share.included_products: Exchange, credit, yield, futures, card (rate unstated), private clients
revenue_share.exclusions: Products not available in all jurisdictions

rules_note: Affiliate track on Impact; Business track on Nexo Partner Portal. Some products cannot be advertised freely; no channel rules published.
allowed_countries_note: Not stated; product availability varies by jurisdiction.

evidence.title: Nexo Affiliate Program page + FAQ
evidence.excerpt: Two tracks; up to 50% of fee revenue; Nexo Card transactions listed as a revenue source without a rate; withdrawals every 30 days.

notes: Card eligibility itself needs >$5,000 portfolio for cashback; commission depends on referred users' fee-generating activity.
